title: Serving Large Language Models on Huawei CloudMatrix384
technique: CloudMatrix-Infer: PD+caching disaggregated peer-to-peer serving, EP320 large-scale expert parallelism, microbatch pipelining, INT8 on Ascend supernode

optimized_metrics.evidence: CloudMatrix-Infer delivers a prefill throughput of 6,688 tokens/s per NPU, and a decode throughput of 1,943 tokens/s per NPU (at <50 ms TPOT).
These results correspond to compute efficiencies of 4.45 tokens/s/TFLOPS for prefill and 1.29 tokens/s/TFLOPS for decode, both exceeding published results
We assess absolute decode throughput (tokens/s) targeting a time-per-output-token (TPOT) SLO of below 50 ms
Minimizing TPOT latency for MoE models requires fine-grained expert parallelism, with each expert placed on a dedicated NPU die.
CloudMatrix-Infer achieves state-of-the-art efficiency without sacrificing accuracy.

headline_claim.text: CloudMatrix-Infer delivers a prefill throughput of 6,688 tokens/s per NPU, and a decode throughput of 1,943 tokens/s per NPU (at <50 ms TPOT). ... sustaining a decode throughput of 538 tokens/s per NPU even under the stricter sub-15 ms TPOT constraint.

reported_metrics.where: Tables 2-4 (per NPU, prefill and decode separately)

metric_definitions.notes: Never formally defined; used as an SLO threshold met by tuning decode batch size; single value per config, no percentile stated

metric_definitions.definition_quote: the system sustains 1,943 tokens/s per NPU for a 4K KV cache Length while maintaining a time-per-output-token (TPOT) consistently below 50 ms
metric_definitions.notes: per-accelerator decode-phase tokens/s at fixed batch (96) and KV length; prefill throughput = input tokens/s per NPU at 16K-token batch

metric_definitions.definition_quote: throughput normalized by the accelerator's computer power (tokens/s per TFLOPS) as an indicator of compute efficiency

slo_spec: decode TPOT SLO of 50/30/15 ms, met by shrinking batch size (128/24/8 per NPU); no attainment percentage
load_regime: fixed batch size per NPU, fixed prompt/KV lengths (offline microbenchmarks mirroring baseline setups)
tradeoff_acknowledged: throughput falls from 1,943 to 538 tokens/s/NPU as TPOT SLO tightens 50->15 ms (batch 96->8)
hardware: Huawei CloudMatrix384 (384 Ascend 910 NPUs, 192 Kunpeng CPUs)
workloads: synthetic fixed prompt/KV lengths (1K-4K), batch sweeps
extractor_notes: Throughput-at-TPOT-bound framing; prefill reports use TTFT only in caching ablation. Perfect-EPLB prefill number (6688) is the headline vs default 5655.
